title: 第3825章 离开古仙路第3824章 闭关神墟宇宙的变化
lines: “宁凡，宁凡哥哥，你怎么了？”
焦急的声音在宁凡耳边响起。
宁凡身体忽然轻轻一颤，原本消失的声音，如同洪水一般，灌入他的双耳之中，眼前世界也是逐渐发生了变化，原本消失的人群逐渐出现了。
“宁凡哥哥，宁凡哥哥～”
红衣少女见宁凡忽然愣在原地，一动不动，神色焦急的不断呼喊。
宁凡终于是反应了过来，心中又惊又喜，他看了眼身旁的红衣少女一眼，内心依旧有些不敢置信，不过，表面上却是装作若无其事，“没，没事。”
见宁凡反应过来，红衣少女明显松了一口气。
“真的，是真的！”
宁凡从红衣少女的身上收回了目光，看向前方那被人群包围的高大雕像，内心激动无比，双手也是因为激动而死死紧握成拳。
刚才一切不是幻象，是真的，因为，他脑海中的那些剑道传承做不得假。
他获得了那位的剑道传承。
忽然。
他心有所感，抬头朝着剑神殿看去，只见半空中一袭青衫的青年，朝着他嘴角含笑的点了点头，然后青衫青年的身影便是诡异的消失了。
果然是他！
许辰！
剑神殿最强之人！
亦是神墟宇宙的第一人。
以一己之力平定了天地大劫！
乃是神墟宇宙禁忌般的存在！
人族之主！
亿万万人族的精神信仰！
亦是所有剑修的楷模与追赶对象。
“小家伙，别辜负了这份传承，若有机会，进入仙界，可到九天仙宗见我！”
许辰的声音在宁凡的耳边响起。
宁凡身体微微一震，瞪大了眼睛。
仙界？！
九天仙宗？！
他记住了！
下一刻。
在所有人惊愕的目光中，宁凡忽然双膝跪地，对着许辰的雕像重重磕了三个响头。
“弟子宁凡，绝对不会辜负师尊教诲！”
“师弟，那个小家伙天赋不错，进入剑神殿后，我会重点培养他的。”
大师兄站在许辰身旁，透过虚空，看向了那跪在雕像前的宁凡，嘴角含笑的说道。
他自然知道许辰刚才赠与宁凡剑道传承的事情，知道宁凡是许辰看中的弟子。
“此子剑道天赋还倒是其次，但他的心境以毅力不错，只要不夭折，日后的成就不会低！”
许辰继续说道：“不必对他太过照顾，想要成为真正的强者，一些荆棘与磨砺，还是免不了的，否则的话，走不远。”
content_en:
"Ning Fan, brother Ning Fan, what's wrong with you?"
An anxious voice sounded in Ning Fan's ears.
Ning Fan's body suddenly trembled slightly, and the sounds that had disappeared flowed into his ears like a flood. The world in front of him gradually changed, and the people who had disappeared gradually appeared.
"Brother Ning Fan, brother Ning Fan~"
The girl in red saw Ning Fan suddenly froze on the spot, motionless, and kept shouting anxiously.
Ning Fan finally reacted, feeling surprised and happy in his heart. He glanced at the girl in red beside him, still a little unbelievable in his heart, but on the surface he pretended to be nonchalant, "No, it's okay."
Seeing Ning Fan react, the girl in red breathed a sigh of relief.
"Really, it's true!"
Ning Fan withdrew his gaze from the girl in red and looked at the tall statue in front of him surrounded by the crowd. He was extremely excited and his hands were clenched into fists due to excitement.
Everything just now was not an illusion, it was real, because the swordsmanship inheritance in his mind could not be faked.
He obtained that swordsmanship inheritance.
suddenly.
Feeling something in his heart, he raised his head and looked towards the Sword Temple. He saw a young man in a blue shirt in mid-air, nodding towards his lips with a smile, and then the figure of the young man in a green shirt disappeared strangely.
Sure enough it was him!
Xu Chen!
The strongest person in the Sword Temple!
He is also the first person in the Shenxu universe.
He single-handedly put down the catastrophe of heaven and earth!
It is a taboo-like existence in the Shenxu universe!
Lord of the human race!
The spiritual beliefs of hundreds of millions of people!
He is also the role model and target for all sword cultivators.
"Little guy, don't let down this inheritance. If you have a chance to enter the immortal world, you can come to the Nine Heavens Immortal Sect to meet me!"
Xu Chen's voice rang in Ning Fan's ears.
Ning Fan's body shook slightly and his eyes widened.
Fairyland? !
Nine Heavens Immortal Sect? !
He remembered!
The next moment.
Under everyone's astonished gaze, Ning Fan suddenly knelt down on his knees and kowtowed three times to Xu Chen's statue.
"Disciple Ning Fan will never let down Master's teachings!"
…
"Junior brother, that little guy has great talent. After entering the Sword Temple, I will focus on training him."
Senior Brother stood beside Xu Chen, looking through the void at Ning Fan who was kneeling in front of the statue, and said with a smile on his lips.
He naturally knew about Xu Chen's gift of swordsmanship inheritance to Ning Fan just now, and knew that Ning Fan was Xu Chen's favorite disciple.
"This son's swordsmanship talent is second to none, but his mentality and perseverance are good. As long as he doesn't die young, his future achievements will not be low!"
Xu Chen continued: "You don't need to take too much care of him. If you want to become a truly strong man, some thorns and hardships are inevitable. Otherwise, you won't be able to go far."
title_en: Chapter 3825 Leaving the Ancient Immortal Road Chapter 3824 Changes in the Retreating Shenxu Universe
